result.notes:
Added orch.agent.started/finished/failed (closed event-data/v1 schemas, valid/invalid fixtures, unit.json, EVENT_TYPES), emitted from roles.agent_start/agent_end so every agent run incl. report-fixer is covered. Subject <run>/<item>/<agent_run_id>, correlationid = run id, causationid of finished/failed = started event id. stage.finished got optional work_id, item, config_digest. events.emit takes correlationid and returns the event id. Test in test_conductor.DigestTests; docs/events.md and CHANGELOG updated. Tests run: test_events, DigestTests, test_conductor_agents, test_characterization, test_boundaries (all green). V1 ran once, exit 0, before the last edits (duration_ms rename, docs, CHANGELOG); the coordinator must rerun it.
